questions.question: What would you do if you were in danger?
questions.translation: ماذا ستفعل لو كنت في خطر؟
suggested_answers: I would stay calm and call for help.
I would shout for help and try to escape quickly.
I would call the police and try to protect myself.

questions.question: Who helps people in emergencies?
questions.translation: من يساعد الناس في حالات الطوارئ؟
suggested_answers: The police and doctors help people in emergencies.
Firemen and rescue teams help people in emergencies.
Doctors, nurses, and the police help people in dangerous situations.

questions.question: What would you do if you had an accident?
suggested_answers: I would stay calm and call an ambulance.
I would call the police and ask for help.
I would try to stay calm and go to the hospital.

questions.question: Why is it important to never give up?
questions.translation: لماذا من المهم ألا تستسلم أبداً؟
suggested_answers: It is important to never give up because we can succeed if we keep trying.
If we stay strong and believe in ourselves, we can achieve our goals.
Never giving up gives us hope and helps us become stronger.

questions.question: What would you buy if you won money?
suggested_answers: I would buy a big house for my family.
I would buy a car and travel around the world.
I would help poor people and give money to charity.

questions.question: Do you think you are lucky? Why?
suggested_answers: Yes, I think I am lucky because I have a healthy family and good friends.
No, I don't think I am lucky, but I am happy with my life.
Sometimes I feel lucky because I have people who love me.

questions.question: What makes a person strong?
suggested_answers: A person is strong when they never give up and face their problems.
Being brave, patient, and believing in yourself makes you strong.
Hope and the will to continue make a person strong.
